title: Norwegians with 24 teeth want to build craft with the US government
summary: Charles Hall tells of Norwegians with 24 teeth want to build craft with the US government, about 1965 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Norwegians with 24 teeth can only repair their craft when they get here, at least in 1965. One of the things they wanted to be able to do was to work with the American government and built craft here.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years around tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, tells of another group of beings he calls the Norwegians, who he says have 24 teeth. He says that around 1965 they could only repair their craft once they got to Earth, and wanted to work with the American government to build craft here. If true, it would mean the US was in talks with more than one kind of visitor.
